senses.exPt: Ele me interrompeu com grosseria enquanto eu falava.

senses.def: dealing with only the most basic parts; simple
senses.ex: I only have a rudimentary knowledge of Spanish.
senses.exPt: Eu só tenho um conhecimento básico de espanhol.

senses.def: the most basic facts or skills of a subject
senses.ex: My grandmother taught me the rudiments of cooking when I was young.
senses.exPt: Minha avó me ensinou as noções básicas de culinária quando eu era jovem.

senses.def: a piece of thick material that covers part of a floor
senses.ex: There's a soft rug in front of the fireplace.
senses.exPt: Tem um tapete macio na frente da lareira.

senses.def: a team sport played with an oval ball that players carry and kick
senses.ex: He plays rugby for his university team.
senses.exPt: Ele joga rúgbi pelo time da universidade.

senses.def: to spoil or destroy something completely
senses.ex: The rain ruined our picnic.
senses.exPt: A chuva estragou nosso piquenique.

senses.def: causing great damage or loss, especially of money
senses.ex: The long war had ruinous effects on the economy.
senses.exPt: A longa guerra teve efeitos desastrosos na economia.

senses.def: something that tells you what you must or must not do
senses.ex: You have to follow the rules of the game.
senses.exPt: Você tem que seguir as regras do jogo.

senses.def: a long flat piece of plastic or wood for measuring and drawing lines
senses.ex: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
senses.exPt: Use uma régua para fazer uma linha reta.

senses.def: a person, such as a king, who controls a country
senses.ex: The king was a strong ruler for forty years.
senses.exPt: O rei foi um governante forte por quarenta anos.

senses.def: to make a long, low, deep sound
senses.ex: My stomach was rumbling during the meeting.
senses.exPt: Meu estômago estava roncando durante a reunião.

senses.def: a long, low, deep sound
senses.ex: We heard the rumble of trucks on the road all night.
senses.exPt: Ouvimos o ronco dos caminhões na estrada a noite toda.

senses.def: a story that people tell that may not be true
senses.ex: I heard a rumor that our teacher is leaving.
senses.exPt: Ouvi um boato de que nossa professora vai embora.

senses.def: to move very fast on your feet
senses.ex: I run in the park every morning.
senses.exPt: Eu corro no parque toda manhã.

senses.def: to be in charge of a business or organization
senses.ex: She runs a small restaurant downtown.
senses.exPt: Ela administra um pequeno restaurante no centro.

senses.def: to work, used about machines or programs
senses.ex: This app runs on any phone.
senses.exPt: Este aplicativo funciona em qualquer celular.

senses.def: a time when you run for exercise
senses.ex: I went for a short run before breakfast.
senses.exPt: Fiz uma corrida curta antes do café da manhã.

senses.def: a person, especially a young person, who has left home secretly
senses.ex: The police found the young runaway at the bus station.
senses.exPt: A polícia encontrou o jovem fugitivo na rodoviária.

senses.def: moving fast and out of control
senses.ex: The runaway car crashed into a wall.
senses.exPt: O carro desgovernado bateu num muro.

senses.def: a person who runs, especially in races
senses.ex: She is the fastest runner in our school.
senses.exPt: Ela é a corredora mais rápida da nossa escola.

senses.def: the activity or sport of running
senses.ex: Running is my favourite sport because it's cheap and easy.
senses.exPt: A corrida é meu esporte favorito porque é barata e fácil.

senses.def: a long road at an airport where planes take off and land
senses.ex: The plane is waiting on the runway.
senses.exPt: O avião está esperando na pista.

senses.def: the long stage that models walk along in a fashion show
senses.ex: The models walked down the runway in summer dresses.
senses.exPt: As modelos desfilaram na passarela com vestidos de verão.

senses.def: relating to the countryside, not towns
senses.ex: My grandparents grew up in a small rural village.
senses.exPt: Meus avós cresceram num pequeno vilarejo rural.

senses.def: a need to hurry
senses.ex: Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm in a rush.
senses.exPt: Desculpe, não posso falar agora. Estou com pressa.

senses.def: to go or do something very quickly
senses.ex: We rushed to the station to catch the train.
senses.exPt: Corremos para a estação para pegar o trem.

senses.def: the time of day when many people are travelling to or from work
senses.ex: The trains are always crowded during rush hour.
senses.exPt: Os trens estão sempre lotados na hora do rush.

senses.def: to make a soft sound like dry leaves or paper moving
senses.ex: The dry leaves rustled in the cold wind.
senses.exPt: As folhas secas farfalhavam com o vento frio.

senses.def: a soft sound of things like leaves or paper moving
senses.ex: I heard a rustle in the bushes behind me.
senses.exPt: Ouvi um ruído nos arbustos atrás de mim.

senses.def: covered in rust, or not as good as before because of no practice
senses.ex: My French is a bit rusty because I haven't used it in years.
senses.exPt: Meu francês está meio enferrujado porque não uso há anos.

senses.def: willing to hurt others to get what you want
senses.ex: He's a ruthless businessman who will do anything to win.
senses.exPt: Ele é um empresário implacável, que faz qualquer coisa para ganhar.

senses.def: the quality of not caring if you hurt others to get what you want
senses.ex: He was known for his ruthlessness in business.
senses.exPt: Ele era conhecido pela falta de escrúpulos nos negócios.
